items.title: A Quasi-Direct-Drive Underactuated Asymmetric Hand for Dexterous and Efficient Grasping and Manipulation
items.abstract: In this paper, we present the Berkeley QUAD (Quasi-direct-drive, Underactuated, Asymmetric Design) Hand, a four-finger anthropomorphic robotic hand with 11 degrees of freedom and 8 degrees of actuation. The design utilizes QDD actuation at the base of each finger, enabling high force transparency for dexterous, adaptive performance. However, the low torque density of these actuators traditionally presents major issues with size, weight, and thermal limits. We overcome this by applying bio-inspired asymmetry, delegating dexterity to the radial fingers through individual QDD actuation, and strength to the ulnar finger through an underactuated, compliantly coupled transmission driven by a larger QDD motor. A novel preloaded, linkage-based transmission permits this ulnar coupling in a way that preserves human-like workspace reachability. Under light loads, the ulnar motor drives the third (middle) finger directly for dexterity while the fourth (ring) finger mirrors its motion. However, under larger loads, the middle finger complies while the motor drives the ring finger further downwards and inwards toward the center of the grasp to apply better closure forces. Hardware evaluations validate this architecture, demonstrating that the hand achieves 29 out of 33 Feix taxonomy grasps and exhibits backdrive forces as low as 50 g for delicate interactions. Additionally, the underactuated fourth finger improves grasp closure and provides the spatial efficiency necessary for larger actuation, yielding up to a 96-fold reduction in heat generation during sustained loading. Webpage: https://benudavis.github.io/berkeley-quadhand/

items.llm_tldr_en: Berkeley QUAD is a four-finger anthropomorphic hand using quasi-direct-drive and bio-inspired asymmetry to balance dexterity, strength and compactness.
items.llm_tldr_cn: 准直驱执行器扭矩密度低，带来尺寸、重量与热限制，难以兼顾灵巧与力量。本文提出Berkeley QUAD四指仿人机械手，具有11自由度和8个驱动，采用仿生非对称设计，将灵巧性赋予径向手指的独立准直驱，将力量赋予尺侧手指的欠驱动顺应耦合传动。该设计实现高力透明度的灵巧自适应抓取与操纵，展示了非对称欠驱动方案在仿人灵巧手上的有效性。
